pages.description: Hideaways Camelthorn Bush Camp is a rustic tented camp set deep in the African bush near the Khwai Concession and Moremi Game Reserve.

Tucked beneath towering camelthorn trees, Camelthorn Bush Camp is an authentic tented camp set deep in the heart of the African bush, near Moremi Game Reserve and Chobe Corridor, with easy access to Khwai River. Perfect for those seeking a rustic safari experience in one of Botswana’s most wildlife-dense regions, offering a raw, no-frills adventure in the wilderness.
The camp’s Oasis Tents provide a simple yet comfortable retreat, blending in with the earthy surroundings. Here, the focus is on experiencing the raw beauty of the bush—whether you’re tracking big game on game drives, drifting through the waterways on a mokoro excursion, or sitting around the bonfire as sounds of the wild fill the air. With bucket showers, solar-powered lighting, and a commitment to minimizing our environmental footprint, Camelthorn offers the perfect opportunity to disconnect from the modern world and reconnect with nature.
SEASON
April - September
CHILD POLICY
Children aged 7 years and older are welcome
ACCOMMODATION
7 Oasis Tents
FACILITIES
Lounge Tent, Bar Tent, Dining Tent
Featuring 7 Oasis Tents fitted with twin beds and en-suite bathrooms, designed for comfort in the heart of the bush. The tents are equipped with solar battery lights, offering a true off-grid experience.
Facilities:
7 oasis tents with private patio (twin-sized beds)
Communal lounge tent
Bar Tent with a solar-powered charging station
Dining Tent with tea and coffee station
Amenities:
En-suite bathrooms in each tent
Bucket showers in each tent (prepared by staff upon request)
Flush Toilets
Main Area bathrooms
3 flush toilets,
2 wash basins with running water
Solar-powered lighting in communal areas and tents
Wireless internet available
Camelthorn Bush Camp is conveniently situated just 92km from Maun, making it easily accessible for travelers arriving at Maun Airport. For self-drivers, the camp is an accessible option, located about two hours north of Maun via well-traveled routes or arrange road transfers from the airport directly to the camp. Guests can reach the retreat by light aircraft, helicopter transfer, road transfer or self-drive.

Air Transfer Options
The quickest way to access Hideaways Camelthorn Bush Camp is by helicopter from Maun International Airport , landing directly within the private concession. Alternatively, guests can fly by light aircraft from Maun or Kasane to Khwai Private Airstrip before continuing by road to the camp.
Hideaways Camelthorn Bush Camp can be accessed by helicopter or via Khwai Private Airstrip.

Guests travelling from Maun journey north towards Hideaways Camelthorn Bush Camp, set within the same 85,000-hectare private concession as Hideaways Mankwe Tented Retreat, on the eastern edge of the Okavango Delta. Its location places guests within reach of Moremi Game Reserve, the Khwai area and the wider waterways of the Delta.

As road conditions can vary depending on the season, guests are advised to contact our Reservations Team before departure for the latest route information and recommended directions to the camp.

About Hideaways Africa Life-Changing Experiences
Skip to content
About Us
Hideaways Africa
Garth's Story
It’s been over thirty years since Garth Jenman began his safari with Camp Wild Safaris in Zimbabwe. Driven by a love for wildlife and adventure, Garth initially led camping expeditions, which earned him a reputation as an innovator in the tourism industry. This deep affection for Southern Africa, its people, and its wildlife culminated in the birth of Hideaways Africa.
Our company has a mission – to create life-changing safari experiences for eco-conscious travelers who want to enjoy and appreciate the untouched beauty and remote locations of Africa. Garth started the Hideaways story in 2012 when the first eco-lodge in the collection was built entirely by hand.
Garth was at the forefront of forging close collaborations with local communities to bring his dream to life. Since then, the Hideaways portfolio of lodges and camps has expanded to locations hidden away in some of the wildest regions of Zimbabwe, Botswana, Zambia and South Africa.
What Motivates Us
At Hideaways Africa, we believe in life-changing experiences and the power of travel to transform. It s not just about the incredible memories you will create on safari, but the positive impact your journey has on the lives of others. You are making a difference when choosing Hideaways Africa:
We create jobs and opportunities for the local communities, ensuring a brighter future for generations to come. Through the Grow Africa foundation, we support scholarships for rural children, fostering future conservation leaders.
Sustainable practices and responsible tourism minimize our environmental footprint, safeguarding the wilderness areas and ecosystems that provide habitats for our beloved African wildlife.
At Hideaways Africa, it is all about you. Let us help you create a safari that will be a life-changing experience and the most memorable of holidays, uniquely curated to what you prefer and what you enjoy while relaxing in the African wilderness.
Our Personal Approach
At Hideaways Africa, we don t just create safaris, we craft unforgettable adventures tailored entirely to your personal preferences. Explore Africa at your own pace, with every detail designed to reflect your interests and needs. Whether you crave action-packed days filled with wildlife encounters or prefer a slower pace soaking in the scenery, the choice is entirely yours.
Commitment fuels every aspect of your experience. From the moment you arrive, the enthusiasm and warm hospitality of our staff is a stand-out. Our chefs curate gourmet meals that tantalize your taste buds, while our guides share their infectious passion for the incredible wildlife you ll encounter.
Our eco-friendly lodges in Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, and South Africa provide the perfect blend of comfort and style allowing you to relax in splendor while knowing your footprint is minimal. It s all about you, so let us help you create a safari that will be a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.
Who We Are
At the heart and soul of Hideaways Africa are Sulet Burger-Prinsloo (Head of Hideaways) and Nicole Jacobs (Sales Manager). With a combined experience of over 25 years in the industry, they have been here since the beginning and have intimate knowledge of every lodge and camp that is part of the collection. Their love for Africa runs deep and their expertise is unparalleled, making them our most trusted advisors.
The magical touch extends beyond Sulet and Nicole. At every Hideaways lodge and camp, you will encounter a team who shares the same dedication. Their smiles are genuine, their knowledge boundless, and their commitment to creating unforgettable experiences for their guests shines through each and every interaction. It is this collective spirit, the love for Africa’s wilderness, and the passion for brand excellence, which makes Hideaways truly special.

Hideaways Africa proudly holds membership in several associations dedicated to fostering the travel trade industry, promoting tourism to the African continent, and actively engaging in both local and global African projects. As a member of these associations, Hideaways Africa remains steadfast in its mission to contribute to the growth and positive impact of the African tourism landscape while fostering meaningful connections within the global travel community.

Need Help?
Get in touch with our dedicated reservations department, where our consultants are eager to assist you in selecting the ideal destination and lodge that perfectly aligns with your preferences. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we re committed to ensuring that your safari experience exceeds all expectations. Let our experts guide you through the exciting possibilities and help you craft a journey that will create lasting memories.
Talk To Us: +27 (0) 21 671 7729 | Email: [email protected]
Our Zimbabwe Lodges
The exquisite wilderness location of our Zimbabwe safari lodges in the vicinity of the wildlife wonderland that is Hwange National Park, makes for an unforgettable experience. The proximity of Nantwich Lodge to Victoria Falls makes it the perfect place to explore “The Smoke That Thunders”. Take a northern turn for a water safari on the Sovereign Houseboat and use Masumu River Lodge as your base. Marvel at the vast expanse of Lake Kariba from the vantage point at Kariba Safari Lodge before being enchanted by the natural setting of Mana Pools Safari Lodge. For a genuine African cultural immersion, the remarkable Zimbabwean landscape at Shashani Matobo Hills Lodge is without rival.
Our Botswana Lodges
Our lodges and safari experiences in Botswana have been hand-selected to guarantee life-changing experiences for those travellers undertaking a journey to this pristine environment. Bordered by  Chobe National Park  and Moremi Game Reserve,  Mogotlho Safari Lodge , Khwai River is the ideal choice for safari enthusiasts with ample opportunity to observe the most iconic species. The allure of  Camp Kuzuma , Chobe lies in its setting amid the magnificent wildlife corridor between Chobe and Hwange National Parks. These safari areas are renowned for exceptional natural encounters of the up close and personal kind.
Our Safari Packages
Discover the essence of Africa with our crafted safari packages  to the unspoilt wilderness areas of Zimbabwe and Botswana. Embrace the diversity of the neighbouring regions’ landscapes, wildlife and adventures with a host of specially designed itineraries, each with a true connection to nature at its core. Whether on a game drive, walking in the bush with an expert guide, or chasing an adrenaline rush, the possibilities are endless. Explore Southern Africa’s wild and wonderful places with Hideaways and our magnificent safari experiences.

Introduction
Facilities

Rates
Mankwe, meaning mother leopard, is a serene sanctuary situated on a private concession east of the Moremi Game Reserve , just 85 kilometers from the vibrant tourism hub of Maun. A hidden oasis on the edge of a wilderness paradise, Hideaways Mankwe Tented Retreat offers a rare and intimate safari experience in the heart of Botswana. A gateway to the Okavango Delta , Khwai region , and Chobe National Park , Mankwe Tented Retreat provides an eco-conscious escape into some of Africa’s most iconic landscapes.
Surrounded by mopane trees and expansive wilderness, Mankwe s elevated Meru-style tented suites, designed with understated elegance, offer sweeping views of the bush from private decks, blending rustic charm with contemporary comfort. The lodge invites guests to not only engage in exploration—whether through game drives in the concession or safaris into bucket-list reserves—but also to take a step back and truly unwind. Interlinked by elevated wooden walkways, Mankwe offers a variety of tranquil spaces to relax, from the serene poolside to cozy nooks perfect for quiet reflection. Evenings bring the magic of the open-air boma, where stories are shared under a starlit sky, completing each day with moments of connection.
SEASON
All Year
CHILD POLICY
Children aged 7 years and older are welcome
ACCOMMODATION
10 Tented Suites
FACILITIES
Spa, 2 x Pools, Intimate Lounge Spaces, Boma
Featuring 10 eco-friendly Meru-style tented suites, each perched on elevated wooden platforms with private balconies sheltered beneath a canopy of mopane trees. Designed with sustainability in mind, the solar-powered tents include en-suite bathrooms with twin basins and a shower offering stunning views. Guests can choose between king or twin beds, dressed in high-end linen with ultra-comfortable mattresses, ensuring a restful stay.
Facilities:
10 Meru-style Tented Suites with private balconies (King or twin-sized beds)
Two pools
Two communal lounges
Spa
Amenities:
En-suite bathroom with shower and twin basins.
Tea and coffee station.
Fans.
Small work desk in each room.
Wireless internet in the business lounge.
Located within the NG43 concession on the eastern edge of the Okavango Delta, Hideaways Mankwe Tented Retreat offers convenient access to the Okavango Delta, Moremi Game Reserve, Khwai and Chobe National Park. Just 92 km from Maun, the retreat is set within its own 85,000-hectare private concession, making it an ideal base for exploring northern Botswana. Guests can reach the retreat by light aircraft, helicopter transfer, road transfer, or self-drive.
